# v0.32.0

## Highlights

This release features 814 commits from 363 contributors (121 new)!

* **Structured decisions and generic parsers**: the new `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint answers `choice`, `noul` and `score` questions over a structured state (#59299), is served by default (#60677, #60696), and also runs on `Cloudflare/clef-omni` (#61064), `LiquidAI/d1-3B` (#60676) and DiffusionGemma (#60466). review_candidates.summary:
<details open>

mtmd: require an F32 position embedding for HunyuanVL (#32131)

HunyuanVL resamples its position embedding on the host into a float
buffer sized for F32, then reads ggml_nbytes() of the tensor into it.
The graph never uses the tensor, so any type loads, and an F64 tensor
overflows the buffer at the first image request.

Require the position embedding to be present and F32 when loading the
HunyuanVL tensors.

</details>

```sh
ollama run autotrust-jev "A customer says their card was charged twice." --ask "Is this a billing issue?"
```
